description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories in the context of automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. There are a total of 12 categories shown. The largest slice is for AI/NLP Research, which constitutes 24.3% of the chart, followed by Game & Anime with 8.2%, and History with 8.2%. The smallest slices are for Math and Geography, each with 1.2% and 2.7% respectively. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are visually distinguished by different colors. The chart does not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized in any particular way. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
